dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at AEON Mall Nilai in Negeri Sembilan, this single-distance 21.1K half marathon is a focused, no-frills race with registration open.
verdict: Nilai 21K is a focused, single-distance half marathon at AEON Mall Nilai in Negeri Sembilan — roughly 45 minutes south of Kuala Lumpur and close to KLIA. The single-distance format keeps the event streamlined, and the mall-anchored venue provides practical race-day logistics. Registration is open. A straightforward, low-friction half marathon for Klang Valley and Negeri Sembilan runners.
